en-US.description: Track AI coding token usage and cost locally, right from the menu bar
en-US.longDescription:
CodeBurn is a free, open-source, local-first tool that tracks AI coding token usage and cost across 41 tools and agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Grok and more), broken down by model, project, and task.
You pay for Claude, Codex, Cursor, and a stack of other AI tools. The bill tells you the total. It never tells you that half of it went to conversation instead of code, or that an expensive model burned your budget on work a cheaper one would have one-shot. CodeBurn does. It reads the session files your tools already write to disk and breaks down every token and dollar by task, model, tool, and project.
Everything runs locally. No wrapper, no proxy, no API keys, nothing leaves your machine. Pricing comes from LiteLLM, refreshed daily.
This package ships the CodeBurn Menubar app: a menu bar item that shows the spend period selected in Settings (Today by default; Week, Month, and 6 Months are also available), with a popover offering agent tabs, period switching, trend, forecast, activity and model breakdowns, optimize findings, and CSV/JSON export, refreshing every 30 seconds.
en-US.name: CodeBurn Menubar

zh-CN.description: 在菜单栏本地追踪 AI 编程的 token 用量与成本
zh-CN.longDescription:
CodeBurn 是一款免费、开源、本地优先的工具，用于追踪 41 种工具与智能体（Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini、Grok 等）的 AI 编程 token 用量与成本，并按模型、项目和任务细分。
你为 Claude、Codex、Cursor 和一堆其他 AI 工具付费。账单只告诉你总额，却不会告诉你其中一半花在了对话而不是代码上，也不会告诉你某个昂贵的模型把预算烧在了换个便宜模型就能一次搞定的工作上。CodeBurn 可以：它读取你的工具已经写在磁盘上的会话文件，把每一枚 token 和每一块钱按任务、模型、工具和项目细分。
一切都在本地运行：没有包装器、没有代理、不需要 API 密钥，任何数据都不会离开你的机器。价格数据来自 LiteLLM，每日刷新。
本包附带 CodeBurn Menubar 应用：一个菜单栏图标，显示设置中所选周期的支出（默认为今天，也可选择本周、本月和近 6 个月），点开弹窗可查看智能体标签、周期切换、趋势、预测、活动和模型细分、优化建议以及 CSV/JSON 导出，每 30 秒刷新一次。
